base_member_text: [L64-L73] (HIGH/dry-cell division) The new hstokes path computes H/hh across the full grid without a positive depth floor, so dry zero-depth cells can produce invalid gamma and zero hstokes.
audit_member_text: [L56-L72] (MED/numerical robustness) Although hhw is protected against dry or negative depth, gamma is computed with the unclamped s%hh, so zero-depth cells can produce infinities or NaNs in hstokes.

base_member_text: [L50-L54] (MED/saved-shape state) The saved gamma work array is never resized if the grid dimensions change.
audit_member_text: [L50-L54,L67] (LOW/persistent allocation) The saved gamma workspace is allocated only once and never checked against later grid dimensions, leaving an undocumented fixed-grid-size lifetime contract.

base_member_text: [L78-L80, L89-L91] (HIGH/periodic scheduling) Wave updates depend on the timestep landing within 0.001*dt of an exact wavint multiple, so non-commensurate dt and wavint values can skip all later scheduled updates.
[L78, L89] (MED/unguarded modulo) The update schedule evaluates mod(t,wavint) without validating a positive nonzero wavint.

audit_member_text: [L75-L115] (MED/configuration validation) The wavemodel select has no default case, so an unsupported value silently performs no wave update.
